name: The Punchline
flavor: You have been setting this up since the fight started, and they have been laughing along with everyone else. Then it lands on them.
description: You deliver the line you have been building toward at one creature that can hear and understand you within range. It makes a Wisdom saving throw against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}. On a failure it takes [[2d6]] psychic damage; on a success it takes half as much. This is plain, reliable damage with nothing attached to it — it is what you do on a turn when nobody needs saving.
narration: The timing is everything and you have had all fight to find it. It lands somewhere behind the eyes, and the worst part is that everyone else in the room laughs.
sheetSummary: Action, 60 ft, cooldown 2. Target must hear and understand you. Wisdom save vs {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}. Fail: [[2d6]] psychic. Success: half damage. No rider.
